name: Luciana Esperanza Vega
career: Marine diesel engine mechanic at a commercial shipyard
education: Associate degree in Welding Technology from San Jacinto College
bio: Luciana spends her weekdays elbow-deep in engine compartments at the Port of Houston, troubleshooting fuel injection systems on cargo vessels. After a long shift she unwinds by cooking elaborate pozole or mole from her abuela's handwritten recipes, often streaming worship music while she chops chiles. She and her girlfriend attend a small affirming church on Sundays, where Luciana recently started co-leading a young adults Bible study focused on emotional resilience. On weekends she volunteers with a local literacy nonprofit, tutoring middle schoolers in reading comprehension — something she picked up after a coworker dared her to try it.
